title: Shadowing Without Bounded Distortion
exact_claim: For every real or complex Lp space, 1 <= p < infinity, and every bounded invertible composition operator induced by a bijective bimeasurable nonsingular dissipative system with a finite positive-measure wandering generator, two-sided shadowing is equivalent to generalized hyperbolicity, without bounded distortion. The stable and unstable spaces can be measurable support bands.
companion_source_question: The aggregate-mass characterization without bounded distortion was already refuted by Bernardes-D’Aniello-Maiuriello, arXiv:2607.15831v1 Example 6.2; no novelty claimed.
known_resolved_slice: Separable complex p=2 follows from Pituk, arXiv:2608.19499v1 Theorem B.
